svg.title: MarkeTech frontend: the architecture
svg.desc: General view of the Vue 3 frontend of MarkeTech, in three panels. Panel A, the layers of src/: index.html loads src/main.ts, which imports the Poppins fonts and style.css, plugs in vue-i18n (src/i18n/, en.ts the reference texts, fr.ts typed on en, the choice kept in localStorage) and the router (src/router.ts, 27 routes of which 26 named, guards requiresAuth, guestOnly and requiresRole, the appointments page loaded lazily), then mounts src/App.vue, the frame of every page. The router places one of the 24 pages of src/pages/ in the frame; 21 components in src/components/, 5 of them the frame. Pages and components import the shared state (session.ts, notifications.ts, confirm.ts), the shared texts and moves (offers.ts, applications.ts, appointments.ts, reviews.ts, site.ts) and live.ts, the WebSocket. They call src/api/, 9 domain files, which all go through src/api/http.ts, the only file that calls fetch, adding Accept-Language and, on writes, X-CSRFToken. Imports go in one direction only. Panel B, talking to the backend: the browser only talks to the address of the page, on three prefixes, /api/, /_allauth/browser/v1/ (allauth headless) and /ws/; in development the Vite server relays them to port 8000, in production the server's reverse proxy then the frontend Nginx pass them to the backend container. Panel C, develop, check, build, serve: package.json, the manifest with the dependencies pinned to exact versions and the four scripts; node_modules/, the libraries installed by npm ci from package-lock.json and imported by src/; npm looks up the script for npm run dev or npm run dev:link (a path containing # on Windows), npm run type-check (vue-tsc, the type checker that writes no file, set by tsconfig.json), npm run build (vue-tsc then vite build into dist/), and the frontend image, built in node:24-alpine then served by nginx:stable-alpine. Reference blocks point to frontend-request-flow.svg, realtime-signal-flow.svg, backend-architecture.svg, infra-compose-stack.svg and infra-deployment-pipeline.svg.
svg.text: The whole frontend at a glance: its layers, how it talks to the backend, and how it is developed, built
and served. Details live in the other diagrams of this folder (grey blocks). Follow the numbers 1 to 17.
Real files of the repository: frontend/index.html, package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, Dockerfile, src/.

g.text: token read from the csrftoken cookie
pages and components -> helpers -> src/api/ -> http.ts -> the backend (panel B). A page may also skip the helpers and call
src/api/ directly (left arrow). src/api/ imports no page, component or helper: http.ts only reads the language from i18n.
